ae2cinematic.hint.drive: Hover a bay to read the cell • Click to pull it out • Hold a cell and click a free bay to slide it in
ae2cinematic.hint.wireless_access_point: Touch the tip with a wireless terminal to link it • Slot boosters into the top of the back plate
ae2cinematic.hint.pattern_encoding_termi: Hold an item and click the grid to ghost it • Smack blank patterns into the box • Hit the button to encode
ae2cinematic.hint.inscriber: Presses go in the top and bottom sockets • What you're pressing goes in the middle • Take the result on the right • Acceleration cards go in the Upgrades column
ae2cinematic.hint.io_port: Drag cells into the left bays • Finished cells wait on the right • Cards go in the Upgrades column
ae2cinematic.hint.vibration_chamber: Feed it fuel • Cards go in the Upgrades column
ae2cinematic.hint.condenser: Put items in the input to destroy them for power • Hit the button to choose Matter Balls or Singularities • Drag a storage component into the bay so it can hold more
ae2cinematic.hint.molecular_assembler: Drag a pattern into the assembler • Acceleration cards go in the Upgrades column
ae2cinematic.hint.pattern_provider: Slot encoded patterns into the provider
ae2cinematic.drag: Drag or scroll to push it in faster
ae2cinematic.drag_in: Click to slide it in (drag to push)
ae2cinematic.ghost_clear: Click with an empty hand to clear
ae2cinematic.ghost_empty: Hold an item and click to set an ingredient
ae2cinematic.encoder.no_recipe: Put a valid recipe in the grid first
ae2cinematic.encoder.no_blank: Smack a blank pattern into the box first
ae2cinematic.button.mode: Click to change what it makes
ae2cinematic.condenser.voiding: Trash mode: items are destroyed, nothing is made
ae2cinematic.condenser.no_component: No storage component: it can't hold power, so items are destroyed for nothing
ae2cinematic.hint.charger: Click the item to grab it out • Hold something chargeable and click to put it in
